title: Expose ticket search to engine and CLI
objective: Add a ticket search capability to the little-mester-mcp ticket engine and CLI so users can standardise searching through existing tickets (initially via grep) instead of loading every ticket into context.

acceptance_criteria.text: The ticket engine exposes a search function (initial implementation via grep over docs/tickets JSON files).
The CLI exposes a ticket-search command that returns matching ticket numbers/titles.
Search supports filtering by area, type, and status in addition to free-text match.
Tests cover search matching and filtering behaviour.
